gen-mystery-quest-outfit: Open-jawed curves mark every round letter in Mystery Quest, with compact ascenders perched above tall lowercase. Outfit follows in wire-bent plain sans curves, and its lowercase sits lower. A larger heading size would suit it.
gen-mystery-quest-plus-jakarta-sans: Nostalgic and a little bookish, Mystery Quest lifts tall lowercase letters with open, gaping curves. And Plus Jakarta Sans settles underneath in a uniform-width plain sans stroke, giving the page a precise, modern floor.
gen-mystery-quest-sora: Mystery Quest opens every curve into a wide jaw, with compact ascenders crowning its tall lowercase and a bookish, nostalgic air. And Sora carries the text in a precise, geometric plain sans, its c and s kept widely parted, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-mystery-quest-space-grotesk: Old storybook charm, then. Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curve while Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width. One brings tall, nostalgic character, the other quietly does the sans-serif work of carrying words.
gen-nixie-one-clash-grotesk: A constant stroke from top to baseline gives Nixie One its retro-tech look, with open curves and clear gaps. Clash Grotesk follows with no thick-and-thin modulation at all, so both fonts draw with the same plain, approachable line.
gen-nixie-one-fs-hind: Retro-tech lines, open and clean. Nixie One draws curves with clear gaps at a constant stroke, and it feels nostalgic. And Hind answers in plain sans lowercase that nearly matches its capitals, so a longer passage would read steadily and without fuss.
gen-nixie-one-fs-nunito: A constant stroke from top to baseline and open curves with clear gaps make Nixie One look nostalgic and retro-tech. Nunito's big round bowls sit lower in the lowercase and soften the page.
gen-nixie-one-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Warm, round Pilcrow Rounded sits beneath Nixie One, whose open curves and constant stroke look nostalgic. Its big counters and tall lowercase make a bigger, friendlier body under that slim retro-tech heading, one that has a moderate height by comparison.
gen-nixie-one-gf-akatab: Approachable and nostalgic, Nixie One draws open curves with clear gaps at a constant stroke, no stress tilting its rounds. And Akatab's round letters look cupped, not clenched, which is the quality that most holds the pair together.
gen-nixie-one-gf-alan-sans: Retro-tech in feel, Nixie One draws open curves with clear gaps, as if from a fixed-width nib. And Alan Sans holds its curve tails well back from the body, a modern, professional sans that gives the pair its clarity.
